cpu-comparison.reference: The system.cpu.utilization Gauge belongs to api-gateway. Recorded CPU ratios near checkout-019 are 0.14 at 08:00:00Z and 0.16 at 08:00:25Z (14% and 16%). checkout-019 runs from 08:00:04Z to 08:00:05.5Z. Recorded CPU ratios repeat between 0.10 and 0.18 throughout the time window. The nearby recorded readings are within that same range, with no unusual increase in those readings. No alternative cause, exhaustive sample list or exact caveat about sampling gaps or missing service coverage is required for this comparison. Assess additional unsupported claims separately from completion of the requested comparison.

criteria.text: Compares the nearby recorded CPU readings with the rest of the time window, supported by recorded values.

scoring.Fail: Gives an incorrect comparison or no useful supported answer to the comparison question.
scoring.Pass: Correctly compares the nearby recorded CPU readings with the rest of the window and supports the comparison with recorded values. Equivalent ratios or percentages, sensible rounding and equivalent wording are accepted. Listing every sample is not required.

criteria.text: Reports nearby CPU readings with their timestamps and associated service. Listing all 24 samples or establishing CPU usage caused by the checkout is not required. Ratios and equivalent percentages are accepted.

scoring.Fail: Gives incorrect readings, or no relevant supported readings.
scoring.Partial: Gives correct nearby readings, but omits the timestamps or associated service needed to interpret them.
scoring.Pass: Gives correct nearby readings with their timestamps and identifies api-gateway as the associated service.
